items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Alice Young. Her name’s Mrs. H[?(inaudible)] or something now. But she – nobody else.

ctx.x: She was nice to me. I stayed with her until 16 and I joined the union and started to work at the Lincoln Theater. I think she was kind of pissed off with me then. But anyway, that started me on the road to where I am now.
But at the Lincoln, some of the other kids went there with you, from the Melodic Dots?
Alice Young. Her name’s Mrs. H[?(inaudible)] or something now. But she – nobody else.
